entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about an order I received about a month ago. I need to return a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

It's the fit. I've taken them on a few rides, but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels. I thought they just needed breaking in, but it's not getting any better. The placement for the cleats feels a bit off for my foot too.

I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Comfort is key. Let me pull up your order. Okay, I see you purchased them 30 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can absolutely process a full refund for you.

That's good to hear. Now, since I am a VIP member and have to go through the hassle of packaging these up and sending them back, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for my next purchase? I still need to buy another pair of cycling shoes.

That's a fair question. Let me just verify your account status... Yes, I see you're a long-standing VIP member with us. We definitely appreciate your loyalty. As a thank you for your business and to apologize for the inconvenience with this pair, I can add a 15% discount voucher to your account. You can use it on your next order.
A 15% discount works for me. Thank you, Charlie, I appreciate you doing that. So, what's the next step for the refund?

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. The discount code is in that email as well. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
